english.title: Racially aggravated fear of violence - words
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used towards **(..SPECIFY PERSON(S) OR ANOTHER..) threatening, abusive or insulting words or behaviour, being racially aggravated in accordance with section 28 of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998, with intent to cause

(A)_[that person]_
(B)_[those persons]_

to believe that immediate unlawful violence would be used against

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_
(E)_[them]_

by any person, or to provoke the immediate use of unlawful violence by

(F)_[him]_
(G)_[her]_
(H)_[them]_

whereby

(I)_[that person was]_
(J)_[those persons were]_

likely to believe that such violence would be used, or it was likely that such violence would be provoked
english.legislation: Contrary to section 31(1)(a) and (4) of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use towards another threatening/abusive/insulting words/behaviour
with intent to cause that person to believe that immediate unlawful violence
would be used against him/her/another by any person or
to provoke the immediate use of unlawful violence by that person/another or
whereby that person was likely to believe that such violence would be used or
likely that such violence would be provoked which was racially aggravated

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording is OBSOLETE. Now see CJS Code CD98066 and Offence Wording H10003.

(i) The option to return an alternative verdict of guilty of the basic offence is NOT available in the magistrates court, therefore the basic offence should be charged in addition to the aggravated offence.
(ii) For the religiously or religiously/racially wordings see offence wordings: H4730 and H4731.
